title.narrative: SUNREF India Housing

description.narrative: The Action aims at reducing the negative impact on the environment caused by the rapid growth of the housing industry in India by supporting the development of affordable green housing. It consists of two compenents: a credit and loan facility for green housing, and a Project Management Unit that is in charge of running it.

title.narrative: Population benefitting from improved housing condition

description.narrative: 1) to spur technical measures on energy and environments efficiency beyond existing rules in the housing sector by promoting two existing and ambitious local green housing labels, namely the Green Rating for Integrated Habited Assessment (GRIHA) and the Indian Green Building Council (IGBC); 2) to provide financial intermediaries and housing developers with technical and financial support (through a Technical Assistance (TA) component and a Credit Facility component); 3) to ease the scaling up of the green housing industry, in particular concerning the affordable housing subsector; 4) to reinforce NHBs institutional capacities in supporting the nascent green housing market and the stakeholders active in this sector; and 5) to ease the early adoption of rules favourable to green housing in the public policies of selected Indian State
